settings.heading: A workshop, not a factory
settings.text:
Pitriciacle grew out of a simple observation: the most beautiful objects in Indian homes were never mass-produced. They were carved, hammered, woven and polished by hand — slowly, by people who knew their material intimately.

We partner directly with artisan families in Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh and Punjab. No middlemen, fair prices agreed in advance, and designs developed together — heritage techniques, composed for contemporary rooms.

settings.heading: Hands that remember
settings.text: Behind every arch mirror is a carver who learned from his father; behind every kansa bowl, a metalsmith who reads alloy the way others read weather. These pages introduce the hands behind the work.

settings.answer: Because each piece is made to order and finished by hand. We would rather deliver late than deliver something we would not keep in our own homes.
